svg.title: Four applications joined to six data sources by twenty-four separate lines
svg.desc: Four application boxes down the left, six data source boxes down the right, and twenty-four separate lines crossing the middle so that every application reaches every data source directly. The lines are drawn in the alert color and overlap heavily, which is the point: each one is a bespoke integration somebody has to write and maintain. A caption reads 4 x 6 = 24 integrations.
svg.text: Four applications, six data sources, wired by hand
Every pair needs its own integration. Nobody ever builds them all.
